ticket.title: Support collapsible control groups
ticket.body:
User clarification: Lux Orchestrator may prioritize, plan, delegate and implement this feature when it makes sense under the existing project workflow. The instruction not to implement applies only to the creative-session assistant in task 01a09bd8-eac1-7a72-a6d1-50c61958ed13. No additional user approval is required solely because the earlier ticket text called this backlog-only.

Problem: During the Prismatic Kaleidoscope creative session, the user liked the visual but found the flat list of 13 controls hard to read.

User result: Organize related controls into named, collapsible groups. Expand Kaleidoscope to adjust its pattern. Collapse it to focus on Spiky Ball controls.

Acceptance:
- Authors can organize controls into named groups with a predictable display order.
- Users can expand and collapse a group without changing values or playback.
- Existing ungrouped controls remain usable. Group headers and controls work with keyboard navigation.
- The grouping design accommodates controls exposed from component subtrees. Preserve component identity so future grouping can follow the component being controlled.
- Demonstrate the two groups in the actual Prismatic Kaleidoscope workflow.

Why record now: This is direct feedback from using the creative controls, not a speculative framework. It supports the LUX-4 milestone of adjusting one declared visual control and the LUX-3 milestone of controlling composed components independently. Existing flat numeric declarations do not provide group metadata or collapse behavior.

Keep scope on control organization. Coordinate with the subtree-control exposure request before fixing the grouping contract. Update the shipped visual-creation skill when author-facing behavior is eventually delivered.

Reference: C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/visuals/Prismatic Kaleidoscope.lux-scene. User feedback in task 01a09bd8-eac1-7a72-a6d1-50c61958ed13 on 13 September 2026.

Related requests: LUX-98 (descriptions) and LUX-99 (subtree exposure and future automatic component grouping).

Approved clarification from task 01a0a7bb-ee60-76f1-bcd6-5d179614f551: named groups such as Motion are collapsible subsections inside the existing collapsible Controls section. Apply to scene and component controls. Update the authoring skill so agents use meaningful groups by default when organizing related controls, while keeping small sets simple. Install/check the shipped skill. Demonstrate nested disclosure and keyboard behavior; preserve animation and values while collapsing.
